findings.evidence: Lines 91–100 prove the laws solely with `toMonoidHom_id`, `toMonoidHom_comp`, and Mathlib’s `mapDomainBialgHom_id/comp`; Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/MonoidAlgebra.lean:72–75 states those laws without finite-generation hypotheses.
findings.fix: First define `CommGrpCat ⥤ CommHopfAlgCat R` using `MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom`, then obtain this functor by restricting the source to `FGCommGrpCat` and lifting the target using `MonoidAlgebra.finiteType_of_fg`.
findings.issue: `coordinateRingFunctor` duplicates the identity/composition proof at the special finite-type level; the group-algebra Hopf functor itself requires no `Group.FG` assumptions.

summary: The categorical group-algebra construction is introduced only at the finite-generation restriction, although its functorial content naturally applies to all commutative groups.
